Name: Naboth the Jezreelite
Summary: Naboth the Jezreelite refused to sell his ancestral vineyard to Ahab, and Jezebel had him falsely accused and stoned so Ahab could take it; Elijah met Ahab there with judgment.
KeyStory: Naboth refuses, is stoned, and Ahab takes his vineyard.
LifeLesson: An inheritance kept by faith is worth more than a king's price, even at the cost of life.
